$comment: Per-game routes and real-input timelines for tools/quality-rebuild-capture/capture-games.mjs. Key names are DOM KeyboardEvent.code values. Timelines use only the controls a player has (keyboard, pointer drag, focus/click): no debug hooks, no ?capture= review lenses, so screenshots show the shipped experience. Step vocabulary is documented in README.md. Timeline time 0 is the first step after the 01-title shot.

games.title: Aura Clash Arena
games.notes: Round auto-starts (1.35s ROUND intro). Controls from src/playable/AuraClashArenaApp.ts actionKeys: A/D move, W jump, S down, Space dash, Shift/Q guard, J light, K heavy, L special (meter-gated), P pause, R reset. Action shot waits for proof.totalHits to increase.

games.title: Blockfall Reactor
games.notes: Boots straight into play (attract mode only after 45s idle). A/D move, W/X/E rotate CW, Z/Q rotate CCW, S soft drop, Space hard drop, C/Shift hold, P pause. Action shot is taken 60ms after a hard drop (lock/impact FX); a line clear is not reliably reachable blind in 15s.

games.title: Skyline Runner
games.notes: A/D run, W/Up/Space jump, Shift/K dash, J/L fire, G ghost, P pause, R reset. Hold run right with periodic jumps; mid shot is taken mid-jump with run held.

games.title: Turbo Drift Circuit
games.notes: Start lights only advance while throttle/drift is held (startLights in src/main.ts), so throttle is held from t=0. W/Up throttle, S brake, A/D steer, Space/Shift drift, P pause, R reset. 02-opening may still show the light ceremony if it runs longer than 2s; 03-mid is inside a held right drift.

games.title: Siege Golf
games.notes: Left/Right aim, hold Space to charge and release to strike, J precision strike, R hole reset, T round reset, P pause. Opening shot is the first ball in flight; 05-charge shows the charge meter.

games.title: Aurora Lander
games.notes: The boot drop falls untouched, so thrust starts at t=0. W/Up thrust, A/D lateral, Space quick restart, R restart, G ghost, P pause. Action shot waits for a touchdown/crash state (regex on evidence state/phase) to capture landing dust or the crash.

games.title: Neon Swarm
games.notes: Wave 1 begins after a 3.2s intermission (INTERMISSION_FIRST_SECONDS). WASD move, J fire (held), Space/K burst, Shift dash, P pause, R reset. Action shot waits for a kill; 05-burst fires burst (only visible if charged).

games.title: Gravity Post
games.notes: Launch is pointer-drag only: launchActiveAim() in src/main.ts is defined but never called, so no key launches the pod (A/D/Z/X only steer the keyboard aim preview). Drag vector (-4,-79)px from the stage centre is the verified contract-one delivery (tests/browser/gravity-post-scene.spec.ts). While coasting: hold Space time-warp, W/S burns, X skips flyby, N next, R retry, P pause.

games.title: Courier Rush
games.notes: Playable spec clicks the canvas before driving. W throttle, S brake, A/D steer, Space handbrake, E interact, P pause, R reset. 03-mid is a held handbrake turn; action waits for a collision strike (evidence strikes) else times out.

games.title: Pulse Tunnel
games.notes: Mounts in state 'ready'; the first key gesture (Space) starts the run. A/D lane, W jump, S slide, P pause, R restart. Lane/jump inputs are blind (not beat-synced), so a miss/fail frame is possible and is itself useful evidence.

games.title: Mech Hangar
games.notes: Starts in the hangar builder: Digit1-4 select slot, Left/Right cycle part, Enter locks the build and enters the arena (72-frame countdown). Arena: A/D move, Space jump, J light, K heavy, L special, Shift guard, P pause. 02-opening is the customised hangar; 02b is the arena after the countdown.

games.title: Vault Breakers
games.notes: Hold Space to pull the plunger, release to serve (1.8s hold matches the thumbnail producer). A/Left left flipper, D/Right right flipper, S nudge, P pause, R reset. Action waits for a score change.

games.title: Rooftop Buckets
games.notes: Hold Space to charge, release to shoot (26 frames ~ 0.55-0.7 power per playable spec). A/D change spot, W/S aim, P pause, R reset. A 'Heat Cleared' modal (#rb-modal-btn) may appear after enough makes; it is captured as-is. Action waits for evidence makes to increase.

games.title: Gallery Shift
games.notes: WASD move, Shift sneak, X sprint, E lift exhibit (hold), P pause, R restart. Blind movement; action is a lift attempt and may show a guard detection instead.

games.title: Deep Recovery
games.notes: Raw window keydown handler: W/S throttle, A/D turn, Q dive, E surface, Shift sprint, Space sonar ping, F grapple, C repair, P pause, R reset. Action is a sonar ping (ring VFX) 250ms after the key.

games.title: Patrol Wing
games.notes: Starts in 'preflight' on the pad; Shift throttles up for a rolling takeoff (takeoffSpeed 10.5). W pitch down, S pitch up, A/D roll, Q/E yaw, Space fire, C camera, P pause, R reset. W is never used (nose-down crash).

games.title: Bank Shot
games.notes: A/D aim, W/S top/draw spin, hold Space to charge, release to strike, P pause, R reset. 02-opening is the break ~500ms after release; action waits for a pot (evidence potted/score).

games.title: Orbital Defense
games.notes: Not deployed (production 404); always built from source and served locally. No per-app vite.config.ts: the wrapper config reuses the root vite.config.ts aliases. A/D rotate, Space fire, Q shield pulse, R reset, P pause. Action waits for score to increase.
